newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank firm, helped by broker comment.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank firm, helped by broker comment.

text.p: Shares in Royal Bank of Scotland were higher in early afternoon, helped by positive comments from brokerage Panmure Gordon, traders said.
The shares firmed 14p to 485-1/2p with Panmure analyst David Poutney rating the stock a "trading buy".
"The shares have underperformed the sector by 20 percent since July and I think they've fallen far too far," Poutney said.
Royal Bank shares have slipped from 519p in mid-August and from the record high of 658p hit at the end of last year when they were pushed up by bid speculation.
